author: ojiudezue
title: Settings: Simple by default, Advanced via HA's own profile Advanced mode
summary: Every URA config/options flow gets a Simple view (fields most people set) and Advanced fields hidden unless the user's HA profile Advanced mode is on (show_advanced_options; fields marked description={'advanced': True}, verified data_entry_flow.py:645-667). Collapsed sections are the middle tier. Folded into the room-type trimmed-menu plan; first use: the lighting manual-hold caps (1 h on / 15 min off) as advanced fields, not device entities.
why: Operator wants rare tuning values exposed but out of the way ('expose them in settings but not in the room device'); HA already provides a per-user switch, so no custom toggle, and it works unchanged in other homes and for family/guest users.
implications: New numbers default to Advanced unless an operator would routinely set them. Advanced mode must reveal every trimmed step so no stored value is unreachable.
revisit_trigger: If Advanced mode proves too coarse (all-or-nothing per user), revisit with per-flow collapsed sections.
